## Relevant Symbols

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:9-10` — job names are the required-status-check contexts; renaming one un-protects the branch.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:172` — matrix job name interpolates `${{ matrix.layer }}`; protection requires the expanded strings (`required-checks.json:10-13`).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:35-37` — only `Secret scan` sets `fetch-depth` (0); every other checkout is the default depth 1 (`:47`, `:56`, `:70`, `:97`, `:104`, `:128`, `:157`, `:214`, `:242`, `:282`, `:317`, `:342`).
- `scripts/required-checks.sh:101` and `apps/web/tests/required-checks.test.ts:70` — `^ {4}name:` is the gate-list regex: **any new job with a `name:` becomes a gate** that must be required or listed in `003 tasks.md` § Missing context.
- `apps/web/tests/required-checks.test.ts:177-187` — the advisory set must equal the documented gaps exactly; a new non-required job fails it.
- `apps/web/tests/lcp-ci-jobs.test.ts:83` — `RUNS_THE_SUITE` matches `vitest` or `pnpm … test` anywhere in a performance job body, including comments.
- `.specify/specs/003-paginas-publicas/tasks.md:620-621` — xp-ledger and write-guard legs are documented gaps (run, not required).

## Markdown the tests read (the FR-002 inputs)

- `apps/web/tests/uploads/limits.test.ts:31` — `join(REPO_ROOT, 'docs', 'tech-stack.md')`
- `apps/web/tests/avatar-budget.test.ts:45` — `join(ROOT, 'docs', 'avatar-budget.md')`
- `apps/web/tests/lcp-measurements.test.ts:46` — `join(ROOT, 'docs', 'lcp-measurements.md')`
- `apps/web/tests/content/xp-erasure.test.ts:318`, `apps/web/tests/accounts/lgpd-doc.test.ts:46` — `docs/lgpd.md`
- `apps/web/tests/accounts/lgpd-doc.test.ts:47` — `docs/backlog.md`
- `apps/web/tests/content-model-doc.test.ts:28` — `docs/content-model.md`
- `apps/web/tests/required-checks.test.ts:52` — `.specify/specs/003-paginas-publicas/tasks.md`
- `apps/web/tests/accounts/avatar-render-deferred.test.ts:34-35` — `.specify/specs/004-contas-avatar/{spec,tasks}.md`

- `apps/web/tests/uploads/limits.test.ts:32-38` — 002 `spec.md` (`'spec.md'` segment `:37`)
- `apps/web/tests/tasks-preamble-facts.test.ts:40-49` — 002 `tasks.md` (`'tasks.md'` segment `:48`)
- `apps/web/tests/checklists-adjudicated.test.ts:41-52` — four checklist `.md` files
- `packages/ui/tests/fonts.test.ts:92-94` — `docs/product/fonts/README.md`, `docs/product/fonts/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICE.md`, `docs/backlog.md` (as provenance exclusions)

That is 16+ literal reads, not a fixed list: the classifier test derives the expected set from
the tree rather than hand-counting it (plan, decision 3). Two **quoted** literal shapes cover every
one: the full repo-relative path (`required-checks.test.ts:52`, `avatar-render-deferred.test.ts:34-35`,
`fonts.test.ts:92-94`), or the basename as its own quoted segment inside `join(…)`
(`limits.test.ts:31,37`, `lgpd-doc.test.ts:46-47`, `tasks-preamble-facts.test.ts:48`). No
template-literal read exists (the only `` `…${…}….md` `` is a message string, `evento.test.ts:169`).
Unquoted mentions are prose, not reads: `README.md` appears unquoted in `apps/web/lib/env.ts:68`
and `packages/game/src/index.ts:13`, and as a substring of `'docs/product/fonts/README.md'`
(`fonts.test.ts:92`) — an unquoted/substring match would make the root `README.md` code. Comments
also name `.md` files in **backticks** (`packages/ui/tests/footer.test.ts:14`).

Consequence of the basename shape: `'tasks.md'` and `'spec.md'` are quoted segments, so **every**
`spec.md` and `tasks.md` under `.specify/specs/*` classifies as code. The same holds for
checklists: `checklists-adjudicated.test.ts:52` quotes `'requirements.md'`, `'api.md'`,
`'security.md'` and `'ux.md'`, so every checklist under `.specify/specs/*/checklists/` with one of
those names — all of them today — is code. Only `plan.md`, `research.md`, `data-model.md`,
`contracts/*`, `spikes/*` and checklists with another name remain docs when no test reads them.

## Tests that read the WHOLE tree (corrects the first draft of this file)

- `packages/ui/tests/fonts.test.ts:159-160` — `git ls-files -z`, then scans every tracked
  non-binary file (`isScanned:168-173`) except `.specify/**` (`:98`), four provenance paths (`:90-95`)
  and itself (`:106`) for SquareFont usage shapes (`USAGE_RULES:117-138`). So `README.md`,
  `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/**/*.md` and `tasks/*.md` are all inputs of `Tests` through this one file;
  `.specify/**` is not. It needs no database. It is the only **unscoped** `ls-files` call.
- Four test files contain the string `ls-files`; only two call it — the two where `ls-files`
  sits inside a single- or double-quoted string literal (comments name it in backticks):
  - `packages/ui/tests/fonts.test.ts:160` — unscoped, above.
  - `apps/web/tests/theme.test.ts:450` — `git ls-files -z -- ...SOURCE_PATHS`, pathspec-scoped to
    `SOURCE_PATHS` (`:438`: `apps/web/app`, `apps/web/collections`, `apps/web/lib`,
    `packages/ui/src`), none of which holds a tracked `.md` today. It reads no Markdown, and the
    file is DB-backed, so it is not a whole-tree test and stays off the docs-only path.
  - `packages/ui/tests/purity-boundary.test.ts:22,660,672,715` and
    `packages/game/tests/purity-fence.test.ts:61` — mentions in comments only, no call.
- The `readdirSync` users read component and test directories, not Markdown
  (`packages/ui/tests/component-barrel.test.ts:28`, `vitest-config.test.ts:56`,
  `palette-tokens.test.ts:137`).

ESLint does not lint Markdown (no markdown plugin; `.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc:18` is the only `.md`
linter, and it is the docs-stage `Markdown lint`).

## Existing Patterns & Conventions

- Shell scripts: `set -euo pipefail`, a long header stating the exit contract, `exit 64` on bad usage (`scripts/required-checks.sh:16-21,35,69`).
- Script tests run the script with `execFileSync('bash', [SCRIPT, …])` and read its usage as the contract (`apps/web/tests/required-checks.test.ts:125-133`, `isolation-mutation-layers.test.ts:37-45`).
- Workflow tests parse `ci.yml` as text with an indentation splitter, no YAML dependency (`lcp-ci-jobs.test.ts:39-67`).
- Every CI job comment explains WHY the job exists and the failure it has already cost (`ci.yml:82-94`, `:253-265`).
- No script under `scripts/` runs git history commands (no `git diff|log|merge-base|fetch` matches), so a deeper checkout changes no existing script.

## GitHub Actions behaviour relied on (platform facts, not in-repo)

- A `pull_request` run checks out `refs/pull/<n>/merge`; with `fetch-depth: 2` its first parent `HEAD^1` is the base tip and `git diff HEAD^1 HEAD` is the whole pull-request change against the base it will merge onto.
- A job-level `if:` is evaluated before matrix expansion; a skipped matrix job reports a single, unexpanded check name.
- A job skipped because a `needs:` dependency failed reports `skipped`, which satisfies a required check.
- A step with `continue-on-error: true` that fails before writing an output leaves it unset;
  `steps.<id>.outputs.x != 'true'` is then true. This holds for the classifier only because it
  writes `docs_only` as its **last** action — a crash earlier cannot leave `true` behind.
